{{Quote|I shall slay you one and all, Skywalker included, replacing you with cybernetically enhanced drones grown from your own tissues and implanted with facsimiles of your own memories.|Zeta Magnus revealing his plans|<ref name="swcw" />}}
A '''clone''' of [[Halagad Ventor]] was created by the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] during the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Origins===
{{Quote|They'd be samples taken before we joined up with Hal, then.|Anakin Skywalker determining when their genetic samples were taken|<ref name="swcw" />}}
In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] preceding the Clone Wars, the [[mutant]] Zeta Magnus escaped his [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Techno-lord|creators]] and wandered the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Shortly after he discovered his creators had programmed an expiration date into his genetic code, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] approached him with an offer of [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] in exchange for his fealty. While Zeta agreed to lend his genetic talents to Sidious and his subordinates, he didn't trust him at all and planned to kill the Dark Lord if he failed to uphold his promise. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] Zeta Magnus plagued the [[S'kytri]] people and declared himself the [[Magister of Skye|Magister]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] in order to provoke a response from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] per Sidious' orders. When [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Commander [[Halagad Ventor]] were dispatched to stop him, Darth Sidious authorized the killing of Kenobi and Ventor. He wanted Magnus to spare Skywalker so he could flourish under his guidance when he returned from Skye. Zeta Magnus ultimately decided to annul is agreement with the Dark Lord and began making preparations to work against him. Before the Jedi left for their mission, Zeta Magnus used his agents to acquire analysis-grade blood and tissue samples of Kenobi and Anakin from a restricted medical source.

===Creation===
{{Quote|But learner Ventor's genetic spawn will join them promptly, at which point cyber-mnemonic implantations shall commence.|Zeta Magnus to the three Jedi|<ref name="swcw" />}}
In the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] of his opulent [[Kharys' fortress|fortress]] atop the [[Canaitith Mountain]] on Skye, Zeta Magnus began to grow a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Anakin Skywalker (clone)|Anakin]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan]]. Zeta used modified Arkanian [[GeNode]] cloning technology in conjunction with forgotten [[Rapid cloning|Jedi cloning techniques]] he acquired from the abandoned cloning lab under the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to create two stable clones of the Jedi in mere [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. By the time Anakin, Obi-Wan, and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Halagad Ventor reached the fortress and were captured, the clones had grown to the equivalent age of ten standard years. Since the clones were nothing more than mindless husks, Zeta Magnus placed [[Mindscan droid]]s on the Jedi's heads to scan their minds. Once their scans were complete, the droids would [[Flash pumping|flash-pump]] all of the Jedi's memories to their clone's minds. To ensure the clone's loyalty and subservience, [[cyber-mnemonic implant]]ations would be installed that gave Zeta Magnus total control over their minds and turned them into obedient drones. Since the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count of the clones were the same as their templates, Zeta Magnus would have two fully trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Jedi at his disposal.

===Destruction===
{{Quote|Youngling killer.''"<br />"''At least I don't salivate as I slowly spit-roast 'em on my lightsaber, Chosen One.''"|Halagad Ventor and Anakin Skywalker arguing after the clone's destruction|<ref name="swcw" />}}     
At the time of the Jedi's capture, only the clones of Obi-Wan and Anakin had been growing. While the three Jedi were knocked out for thirty minutes from a stun blast, Zeta Magnus collected genetic material from Halagad and began to process it. Zeta Magnus revealed that he had been instructed to kill Kenobi and Ventor so young Skywalker could flourish under his benefactor's guidance. Instead of killing the two Jedi and returning the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] to Darth Sidious, Zeta planned to create three obedient Jedi slaves and return a clone of Anakin to Sidious. While Anakin served as Sidious's confidant, the Sith Lord would be ignorant to the fact that his protégé was actually a clone [[Spy/Legends|agent]] of Zeta Magnus.

Once the mind scans were complete, Zeta Magnus prepared to execute the three Jedi with his [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]. The Force-sensitive S'kytri [[Kharys]] used the Force from outside the laboratory window to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] the mutant's blade so it struck the torture droid that was preventing the restrained Jedi from using the Force. Once the Jedi freed themselves they began to fight Zeta Magnus and his four [[Thyrsian]] [[Tark Squad|clones]]. Zeta Magnus's commandos attempted to throw a [[Class-D detonator]] at the Jedi's position, but Ventor used the Force to detonate it in his hand. The [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|detonator]] [[Class-D annihilation|annihilated]] the area of the lab where the commandos stood and disintegrated the clones of Anakin, Obi-Wan, and the tank that would hold Ventor's clone.<ref name="swcw" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone of Halagad Ventor first appeared in the novella [[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]] by [[Abel G. Peña|Abel G. Pena]].
